ALTER PROC [BNKM].[SP_CUSTOMERACCOUNTPERIODBALANCE_LNS_EOD_RunBalTranDate] AS
BEGIN
--------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance AS (
-- EOD Running Balance of Transaction Date & TRAN_DATE_BAL
SELECT
	BLG.FORACID AS CustomerAccountId
	,'EOD Running Balance of Transaction Date' AS PeriodBalanceTypeId
	,BLE.EOD_DATE AS PeriodStartDate
	,BLE.END_EOD_DATE AS PeriodEndDate
	,NULL AS BillingCycleId
	,BLE.TRAN_DATE_BAL AS BalanceAmount
	,BLE.EAB_CRNCY_CODE AS IsoCurrencyCode
	,BLE.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,'LNS' AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,BLE.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
FROM BUSC.LNS_EODACCTBAL BLE 
LEFT JOIN BUSC.LNS_GENERALACCTMAST BLG 
	ON BLE.ACID = BLG.ACID 
	AND BLE.BANK_ID = BLG.BANK_ID
	AND BLG.ISLATEST = 1

WHERE BLG.FORACID IS NOT NULL --and BLE.ISLATEST = 1 --AND BLE.EOD_DATE = '2023-01-13' 

)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance;


-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(convert(varchar,CustomerAccountId),PeriodBalanceTypeId,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,PeriodStartDate))
,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,PeriodEndDate)),convert(numeric(18,5),BalanceAmount),IsoCurrencyCode,FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode)) 
	HASHROW
	, CustomerAccountId
    , FinancialInstitutionId
	, PeriodBalanceTypeId
	, SourceSystemCode 
	, PeriodStartDate
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance 

)


,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(convert(varchar,CustomerAccountId)
,PeriodBalanceTypeId
,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,PeriodStartDate))
,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,PeriodEndDate))
,BalanceAmount
,IsoCurrencyCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
,SourceSystemCode)) 
	HASHROW
	, CustomerAccountId
    , FinancialInstitutionId
	, PeriodBalanceTypeId
	, SourceSystemCode
	, PeriodStartDate
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance	
WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'LNS' --AND PeriodEndDate = '2099-12-31' 
AND PeriodBalanceTypeId = 'EOD Running Balance of Transaction Date'

)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountId,TGT.CustomerAccountId) AS CustomerAccountId
    ,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,ISNULL(SRC.PeriodBalanceTypeId,TGT.PeriodBalanceTypeId) AS PeriodBalanceTypeId
    ,ISNULL(SRC.SourceSystemCode,TGT.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode	
	,ISNULL(SRC.PeriodStartDate,TGT.PeriodStartDate) AS PeriodStartDate
	,CASE
		WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS

	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_SRC	SRC
LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.PeriodBalanceTypeId = TGT.PeriodBalanceTypeId
AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
AND SRC.PeriodStartDate = TGT.PeriodStartDate
WHERE (SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW) OR (TGT.HASHROW IS NULL)
)


SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_DELTA;

----UPDATE RECORDS to BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
PeriodEndDate = CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,SRC.PeriodEndDate))
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId  AND DELTA.PeriodBalanceTypeId = TGT.PeriodBalanceTypeId AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode AND DELTA.PeriodStartDate = TGT.PeriodStartDate AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance SRC ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId  AND SRC.PeriodBalanceTypeId = TGT.PeriodBalanceTypeId AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode AND SRC.PeriodStartDate = TGT.PeriodStartDate
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndDate in ('2099-12-31') AND TGT.SourceSystemCode = 'LNS' AND TGT.PeriodBalanceTypeId = 'EOD Running Balance of Transaction Date'

--INSERT RECORDS WITH UPDATE
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance ( 
CustomerAccountId
,PeriodBalanceTypeId
,PeriodStartDate
,PeriodEndDate
,BillingCycleId
,BalanceAmount
,IsoCurrencyCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
,SourceSystemCode
,TaskRunId
,WorkFlowId
,InsertDttm)

SELECT DISTINCT
SRC.CustomerAccountId AS CustomerAccountId
,SRC.PeriodBalanceTypeId AS PeriodBalanceTypeId
,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,SRC.PeriodStartDate)) AS PeriodStartDate
,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,SRC.PeriodEndDate)) AS PeriodEndDate
,NULL AS BillingCycleId
,SRC.BalanceAmount AS BalanceAmount
,SRC.IsoCurrencyCode AS IsoCurrencyCode
,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
,'LNS' AS SourceSystemCodeRECORD_STATUS
,0 AS TaskRunId
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,SRC.InsertDttm AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_DELTA DELTA ON  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS IN ('INSERT') 
AND DELTA.CustomerAccountId = SRC.CustomerAccountId 
AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId 
AND DELTA.PeriodBalanceTypeId = SRC.PeriodBalanceTypeId 
AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = SRC.SourceSystemCode 
AND DELTA.PeriodStartDate = SRC.PeriodStartDate

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_DELTA;

END
GO
